# keyfactor_oauth_security_role (Resource)

Used to manage Keyfactor Command Security Roles using the V2 `/Security/Roles` API. This resource is compatible with Keyfactor Command versions 11+

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "keyfactor_permission_set" "global_permission_set" {
  name = "Global"
}

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "full_permissions_example" {
  name              = "Invalid Role Example"
  description       = "NOTE: This will fail with a `400 Redundant permissions detected` error. This example is intended to outline the full set of permissions that can be assigned to a role."
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/",
    "/agents/",
    "/agents/auto_registration/",
    "/agents/auto_registration/modify/",
    "/agents/auto_registration/read/",
    "/agents/management/",
    "/agents/management/mac/",

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "certificate_admin_role" {
  name              = "Certificate Admin"
  description       = "A security role created through Terraform"
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/certificates/",
    "/metadata/types/read/",
  ]
  # email_address = "foo.bar@example.com"
}

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "super_admin" {
  name              = "Super Admin"
  description       = "Full access to all of Keyfactor Coammand"
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/"
  ]
}

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "certificate_admin" {
  name              = "Certificate Admin"
  description       = "Full access to all of Keyfactor Command certificates"
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/certificates/"
  ]
}

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "collection_admin" {
  name              = "Collection Admin"
  description       = "Full access to all of Keyfactor Command certificate collections"
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/certificates/collections/",
  ]
}

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "collection_five_admin" {
  name              = "Collection 5 Admin"
  description       = "Full access to all of Keyfactor Command certificates in collection 5"
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/certificates/collections/read/5/",
    "/certificates/collections/revoke/5/",
    "/certificates/collections/private_key/read/5/",
    "/certificates/collections/change_owner/5/",
    "/certificates/collections/delete/5/",
    "/certificates/collections/metadata/modify/5/",
  ]
}

resource "keyfactor_oauth_security_role" "collection_five_user" {
  name              = "Collection 5 User"
  description       = "Can read/download certificates and private keys in certificate collection 5"
  permission_set_id = data.keyfactor_permission_set.global_permission_set.id
  permissions = [
    "/certificates/collections/read/5/",
    "/certificates/collections/private_key/read/5/",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A string containing the description of the OAuth security role.
- `name` (String) Description of the OAuth security role
- `permission_set_id` (String) The ID of the permission set associated with the OAuth security role. This is used to identify the permissions associated with the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) A list of permissions associated with the OAuth security role. This will return a list of permissions that are associated with the OAuth security role. This is used to identify the permissions associated with the role. For more information about allowed permission values, please refer to the Keyfactor Command [Version Two Permission Model documentation](https://software.keyfactor.com/Core-OnPrem/Current/Content/ReferenceGuide/SecurityRolePermissions.htm#Version2).

### Optional

- `email_address` (String) Email address associated with the OAuth security role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the OAuth security role.
- `immutable` (Boolean) Indicates whether the OAuth security role is immutable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import keyfactor_oauth_security_role.my_security_claim ROLE_ID
```
